svg.title: FileSquid v1 mockup 19: Activity panel with comments
svg.desc: Activity panel: per-file activity (versions, shares, public-link downloads, metadata and tag changes) and comments with a comment box. Mentions notify but never grant access. The panel does not depend on any other panel.
